text:
sophia: FYI - I'm seeing customer reports that they didn't get pages for a critical alert ~8m ago. PD shows no incoming event for that rule. Investigating.

matt: confirmed - our monitoring shows the incidentbot webhook to PagerFlow returning 502s around 10:09-10:14 UTC.

incidentbot: [automated] Alert: rule=email-alerts/critical_latency triggered at 2024-11-12T10:08:52Z, attempted webhooks failed (x3)

jordan: did the bot try the fallback PD integration? that should push to the secondary integration if primary failed.

lia: it didn't. logs show the payload had missing escalation_policy_id after a recent config rollout. seeing: 
```
ERROR: missing required field: escalation_policy_id
POST /webhook/pagerflow 400 
{"payload":{...}}
```

matt: that's the rollout I pushed earlier (pagerflow integration schema change). the migration script should have backfilled that field. looking now.

ops-oncall: customers impacted? which tenants? any P1s opened?

emily-cs: got 3 customer tickets complaining about delayed ops notification; two of them labeled priority-high. I'm fielding and will escalate if they ask for an update.

jordan: quick mitigation: I'm going to manually trigger pages for the failed alerts and add missing escalation_policy_id before retrying. can someone confirm permission so I can invoke the admin endpoint?

sophia: go ahead — granting temporary token to @jordan (valid 15m).

incidentbot: [system] manual re-send attempted by jordan at 10:17 UTC: webhook retry queued (id=wr_729).

matt: confirmed migration backfill missed ~12 entries; patching the migration now. ETA ~12m. will also add validation to the deploy pipeline to prevent this schema gap.

lia: ops-oncall — we had an on-call handoff 09:50; did the new lead get the escalation keys? potential cause for missed manual followups.

ops-oncall: handoff confirmed but didn't get the PD escalation id list — looks like the secret sync job failed at 09:45 with a transient 504 to vault. that's probably why migration assumed a default and stripped the field.

emily-cs: customers want an ETA. can we confirm who we should update? I'll post single consolidated status message once we have timeline.

matt: migration patched and re-run at 10:30 UTC. backfill completed for affected integrations. watch logs for retries.

incidentbot: [system] webhook retry success: wr_729 delivered to PagerFlow at 10:32 UTC (200 OK).

jordan: manual pages sent for the three reported incidents. customers notified. lia — can you verify that PD incidents were created with correct escalation?

lia: verified — escalation policy attached, oncall paged.

ops-oncall: thanks, team. immediate mitigation done. next: postmortem to root cause two things: (1) secret sync 504 -> missing escalation ids; (2) deploy migration didn't fail on missing fields. assign owner?

matt: I'll own the migration validation fix and follow-up infra fix for secret sync alerts.

sophia: assigning postmortem lead to matt. please include timeline + customer impact (ticket ids: CS-4482, CS-4483, CS-4484) and remediation steps.

emily-cs: I added those ticket ids to the incident in Zendesk and told customers we expect full writeup in ~48h.

jordan: small follow-up: incident channel automation didn't annotate which on-call was paged; we should add a quick message in the bot that includes both PD incident url and oncall name to avoid manual lookups. filing a small story.

matt: agreed. also adding a safety net: if webhook returns 4xx for schema, queue to a dead-letter and fire an internal alert so we don't silently drop pages.

lia: one last note — can we add a runbook step for ops to manually trigger the PD fallback if secret sync is down? saved us time today.

ops-oncall: noted. I'll add to runbook and schedule a 20m sync to review handoff checklist.

sophia: thanks everyone. closing incident in this channel. follow-up doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-712 (postmortem + action items). :white_check_mark:
